project.name: jawelte (resource-module aggregator)
project.description: @Resource injection, so an application's production wiring runs unchanged in a test. resource-module/api ships the ResourceLookup port - a name to an object, with no assumption that the name lives in JNDI; resource-module/impl ships the CDI extension that fills @Resource fields through it and a default adapter that resolves against the naming tree jndi-module installs. It exists as its own module rather than inside cdi-module because cdi-module is mandatory and must not depend on jndi-module, and rather than inside jndi-module because that module's job is handing out the writable root, not consuming it - @Resource is a consumer of naming exactly as @DataSourceDefinition is. Optional and inert: a deployment with no @Resource field is never touched.
